overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Trinity College men's basketball team, the Bantams, for winning the 2025 NCAA Division III national championship, beating New York University 64-60 on March 22, 2025. It was the first national title in the program's history, capping a 30-3 season, and coach James Cosgrove was named Division III coach of the year. The resolution also praises the college's academic record, congratulates its fans, students and faculty, and sends copies to the college president and coach. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 13, 2025.
for: Supporters say it honors a team's first national championship and the college community behind it.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
